Number: 83 Name: Response Code 
Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 1 byte 
 
Representation: Fixed length of one alphanumeric character 
Purpose: For financial transactions, it identifies an approval with 
purchase/capture, an approval without purchase/capture, or a 
decline. 
 For totals, it identifies an approval, an approval with electronic 
mail retrieval pending, decline with electronic mail retrieval 
pending, approved with electronic mail retrieval pending and 
proprietary data pending, declined with electronic mail retrieval 
pending and proprietary data pending, approved with proprietary 
data pending, or declined with proprietary data pending. 
 For electronic mail, it identifies an approval or an approval with 
more mail pending. 
 For communications test, it identifies an approval. 
 For a TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization transaction, it 
identifies one of the following: 
• The transaction is an approved TransArmor PKI Encryption 
and Tokenization transaction. 
• The transaction is a rejected TransArmor PKI Encryption and 
Tokenization transaction. 
• The merchant is not a TransArmor merchant. 
 For an EMV transaction, it identifies one of the following: 
• The transaction is an approved EMV transaction. 
• The transaction is a rejected EMV transaction.

element is always followed by Data Section No. 2 which contains 
Data Segment No. 100, Standard Message Data Segment, plus 
Data Section No. 3 which contains Data Segment No. 110, Check

Segment. 
 Totals Requests:  This data element is always followed by Data 
Segment No. 105, Totals Data Segment. 
 Electronic Mail Requests:  This data element is always followed 
by Data Section No. 2, which contains Data Segment No. 109, 
Electronic Mail Data Segment.

followed by Data Section No. 2 which contains Element No. 120,
